description:
I'm not a licensed electrician. This channel shares how-to's and tips that may help DIY homeowners — not for beginners.

Disclaimer: Electrical work can cause injury, fire, or property damage if done wrong. This content is for informational purposes only and isn't professional advice. In many areas homeowners are legally allowed to do their own electrical work, but rules, permit requirements, and licensing laws vary by location — it's on you to check and follow your local codes before starting any project. Always turn off power at the breaker, test before you touch, and if you're unsure at any point, hire a licensed electrician. By watching or following this channel, you accept full responsibility for any electrical work you perform, and I'm not liable for any injury, loss, or damage that results.
